verdict.rationale: Calendly offers an AI email assistant (Callie) that coordinates scheduling on your behalf, and group polls that consider everyone's availability, including external attendees. It also offers two-way availability matching when both parties use Calendly and multi-calendar conflict checking. Nothing shows AI choosing an optimal time rather than simply offering open slots, and nothing shows continuous re-optimization of meetings already booked. Missing for 10: AI-driven ranking or optimization of the best time across all attendees, continuous rescheduling/optimization, and documentation of how Callie selects times.
